name: Handy Backup
description_en:
Handy Backup is a product in the Backup and recovery category. Its directory profile covers Incremental Backup, Mobile Compatibility, Web Access, Compression Tools, Automated Storage, Remote Access, Secure Data Storage, Encryption.

Additional listed capabilities include Backup Scheduling. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Desktop App (Windows). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $39.00.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: protect data using supported cryptographic mechanisms; run backups according to a defined schedule. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
